merge into T_GDYY_NOTE a USING (
select #{Attention.bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} big_roll_code, #{Attention.notes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} notes, #{Attention.startTime,jdbcType=DATE} start_time, #{Attention.endTime,jdbcType=DATE} end_time, #{Attention.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} status,

) b ON ( ((b.big_roll_code is null and a.big_roll_code is null) or (a.big_roll_code = b.big_roll_code)) AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.notes = b.notes, a.start_time = b.start_time, a.end_time = b.end_time, a.status = b.status,
